City of Encinitas
AMENDED Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m. (10D(i) and 10D(ii) Added 6/18/2025)(Item 10C - Attachment 4 added 6-23-25)
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, JUNE 25, 2025 -
06:30 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

Presentation of Proclamation to Richard Dascomb for his 50 years of service
2025-06-25 Item 04A Proclamation Richard Dascomb
4B.

2025-06-25 Item 04B Proclamation Parks, Recreation and Cultural Arts Month
4C.
Presentation of Proclamation declaring June Pride Month
2025-06-25 Item 04C Proclamation in Recognition of Pride Month
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Please submit a “WHITE” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Oral Communication items will be referred to the City Manager either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
2025-06-25 Item 05 Oral Communication Received
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. A maximum of two time donations per speaker is allowed (no more than 9 minutes total); the person donating time must be present. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
8A.
Approval to waive the full reading of the text of all ordinances and resolutions introduced/adopted at this meeting. Ordinances and resolutions shall be introduced/adopted by title only. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve.
8B.
Approval of the Minutes of the June 11, 2025, Special-Closed Session Meeting; and June 11, 2025, Special Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2025-06-25 Item 08B Minutes
8C.
Approval of the Warrants List (Register of Demands). Contact Person: Finance Manager Dinh
Staff recommends that the City Council review and approve the warrants.
2025-06-25 Item 08C Approval of Warrants
8D.
Accept California Department of Housing and Community Development (HCD) Permanent Local Housing Allocation (PLHA) Award in the amount of $236,309. Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the City Council is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a "project" under Section 15378(b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. The action involves an organizational or administrative activity of government that will not result in the direct or indirect physical change in the environment. Contact Person: Management Analyst Holcombe
Accept California Department of Housing and Community Development (HCD) Permanent Local Housing Allocation (PLHA) Grant Award in the amount of $236,309 and authorize the City Manager, or designee, to execute the standard agreement.
2025-06-25 Item 08D Permanent Local Housing Allocation Grant Award
8E.
Award an agreement with Interwest Consulting Group to provide On-Call Tenant Relocation Services. Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the City Council is not subject to the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to Section 15060(c)(3) of the CEQA Guidelines because it is not a "project" under Section 15378(b)(5). The action involves an administrative activity of government that will not result in a direct or indirect physical change in the environment. Contact Person: Associate Planner IV Cvetko
Authorize the City Manager, in consultation with the City Attorney, to execute an agreement in substantial form with Interwest Consulting Group to provide on-call tenant relocation services in accordance with applicable state law, including any necessary amendments and time extensions.
2025-06-25 Item 08E On-Call Tenant Relocation Services Agreement
8F.
Amendment to Project Management Agreement for the Leucadia Streetscape Segment C West Project (CS23D) and North Highway 101 Drainage Improvements Project (CD23A). Environmental Considerations: Pursuant to the California Environmental Quality Act, environmental clearance for the project was provided under the Final Environmental Impact Report for the North Coast Highway 101 Streetscape Improvement Project (10-035 DR/CDP/EIR and 10-036 GPA/SPA/LCPA) and the Addendum to the Final Environmental Impact Report (SUBC-005527-2022) and NEPA was completed (HUD Grant No. B-23-CP-0159, SCH No. 2015091084) for the North Highway 101 Drainage Improvements Project (CD23A). Contact Person: Principal Engineer Widelski
Authorize the City Manager, or designee, to execute Amendment No. 5 in substantial form, and any necessary amendments and time extensions in consultation with the City Attorney, with Kleinfelder Construction Services, for project management support on the Leucadia Streetscape Segment C West Project (CS23D) in the amount of $250,000 for a new total not-to-exceed amount of $1,250,000.
2025-06-25 Item 08F Streetscape Seg. C - KCS PM Contract Extension-2025
8G.
Memoranda of Understanding (MOUs) with the Encinitas Union School District and the San Dieguito Union High School District for the Bicycle Safety Education Program for the 2025-26 School Year. Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the City Council is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a "project" under Section 15378(b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. The action involves an organizational or administrative activity of government that will not result in the direct or indirect physical change in the environment. Contact Person: Mobility Manager Buck
1) Authorize the City Manager, in coordination with the City Attorney, to execute a Memorandum of Understanding between the City of Encinitas and the Encinitas Union School District (EUSD), in substantial form, to fund up to $30,600 for bicycle safety education at multiple schools; and 2) Authorize the City Manager, in coordination with the City Attorney, to execute a Memorandum of Understanding between the City of Encinitas and the San Dieguito Union High School District (SDUHSD), in substantial form, to fund up to $16,200 for bicycle safety education at multiple schools.
2025-06-25 Item 08G MOUS Bicycle Safety Education_EUSD-SDUHSD
2025-06-25 Item 08G MOUS Bicycle Safety Education_EUSD-SDUHSD - Public Comment
8H.
Memoranda of Understanding (MOUs) with the Encinitas Union School District and the San Dieguito Union High School District for School Crossing Guard Programs for the 2025-26 School Year. Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the City Council is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a "project" under Section 15378(b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. The action involves an organizational or administrative activity of government that will not result in the direct or indirect physical change in the environment. Contact Person: Mobility Manager Buck
1) Authorize the City Manager, in coordination with the City Attorney, to execute a Memorandum of Understanding between the City of Encinitas and the Encinitas Union School District (EUSD), in substantial form, to fund up to $150,758 for crossing guards at multiple schools; and 2) Authorize the City Manager, in coordination with the City Attorney, to execute a Memorandum of Understanding between the City of Encinitas and the San Dieguito Union High School District (SDUHSD), in substantial form, to fund up to $42,412 for crossing guards at multiple schools.
2025-06-25 Item 08H MOUs School Crossing Guard 2025-26 School Year
8I.
Acceptance of the Scott Valley Park Equipment Replacement Project (CP24A). Environmental Considerations: The actions being considered by the City Council are exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because they are not a "project" under Section 15378(b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. The actions involve organizational or administrative activities of government that will not result in the direct or indirect physical change in the environment. Contact Person: Senior Engineer Stryker
1) Authorize the filing of the Notice of Completion for the subject project; 2) Authorize the release of the payment bond for the subject project in full upon the recording of the Notice of Completion; 3) Authorize the release of the performance bond for the subject project in full, one (1) year after the recording of the Notice of Completion; and 4) Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2025-67, titled "A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, Accepting the Public Improvements for the Scott Valley Park Equipment Replacement Project (CP24A)".
2025-06-25 Item 08I NOC Scott Valley Park
8J.
Designation of Intersection Control at Saxony Road and Union Street intersection as All-Way Stop Control (AWSC) with Crosswalk on the North Leg of Saxony Road. Environmental Considerations: The proposed action is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to Section 15301(c) of the CEQA Guidelines. This section exempts projects characterized as minor alterations to public facilities, involving negligible or no expansion of the existing use. Contact Person: Traffic Engineer Bandegan
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2025-72 titled, "A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, Establishing All-Way Stop Control at the Intersection of Saxony Road and Union Street."
2025-06-25 Item 08J All-Way-Stop at Saxony & Union St.
8K.
Approve Plans and Authorize Advertisement for the Grandview Stairs Repair Project (CP23A). Environmental Considerations: This project is Categorically Exempt (CE) from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to Section 15301 (d) of the CEQA Guidelines. This section exempts rehabilitation of deteriorated or damaged structures to meet current standards of public health and safety. Contact Person: Engineer I Sanchez
1) Approve the design and plans for the Grandview Stairs Repair Project (CP23A); 2) Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2025-48, titled, "Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, Approving the Design and Plans for the Grandview Stairs Repair Project (CP23A), Pursuant to Government Code Section 830.6;" and 3) Authorize the advertisement of the Grandview Stairs Repair Project (CP23A) for construction bids.
2025-06-25 Item 08K Grandview Stairs Design Immunity
8L.
Award Construction Contract to DB Pipeline, Inc. for the Self-Realization Fellowship Drain Pipe Repair Project (CD25A). Environmental Considerations: The project is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Section 15301(c), which categorically exempts minor alterations to existing public streets, sidewalks, gutters, and similar facilities, including the replacement or reconstruction of existing structures and facilities. This exemption includes improvements and alterations that do not create additional automobile lanes. Contact Person: Engineer I Sanchez
Authorize the City Manager, or designee, to execute a contract in substantial form and any necessary amendments and time extension, in consultation with the City Attorney, with DB Pipeline, Inc. in the amount of $137,000 plus 15 percent contingency of $20,550 for a total construction contract not-to-exceed amount of $157,550 for construction of the Self-Realization Fellowship Drain Pipe Repair Project (CD25A).
2025-06-25 Item 08L Self Realization Fellowship Storm Drain Pipe Repair

Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the City Council is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a "project" under Section 15378(b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. 2025-06-25 Item 08N Workstation Refresh Agenda Report

2025-06-25 Item 08O One-Year Management Services Agreements (C101, Chamber, E101 and L101)

Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
